screen.mappywall.tasks.title: MappyWall Jobs
screen.mappywall.tasks.empty: No jobs in this world and dimension.
screen.mappywall.tasks.corrupt: Corrupt save; delete this job and create it again
screen.mappywall.config.title: MappyWall Setup
screen.mappywall.automation_style_toolti: Normal mode mimics view/key input. Aggressive mode keeps a server-facing travel direction independent of free look while enforcing speed safety limits; some servers may prohibit this automation.
screen.mappywall.navigation.title: Aggressive path breaking
screen.mappywall.navigation.reset_done: Restored the default natural-type block-id whitelist
screen.mappywall.navigation.save_failed: Could not write the navigation configuration
screen.mappywall.navigation.breaking_too: Used only by Aggressive mode. Disable it to prevent pathfinding from intentionally breaking blocks.
screen.mappywall.navigation.list_mode_to: Whitelist permits listed blocks; blacklist permits unlisted blocks. Dangerous blocks, fluids, block entities, and unbreakable blocks are always rejected.
screen.mappywall.navigation.priority_not: Breaking is a last resort. Lists match block ids and cannot distinguish natural generation from player placement of the same block type.
screen.mappywall.auto_walk_note: Automatic modes control movement/items; press K to stop.
screen.mappywall.scale_note: Note: empty maps open at vanilla scale 0; craft/zoom them afterward.
hud.mappywall.pause_hint: Press U to pause/resume, M for jobs
hud.mappywall.open_anywhere_in_region: Open the map anywhere inside the target region
hud.mappywall.scale_needs_existing_map: Empty maps open at scale 0; craft/zoom them afterward
hud.mappywall.scale_empty_maps_open_as_z: MappyWall will open a scale 0 map; craft/zoom it to the target scale afterward
hud.mappywall.auto_walk_active: Auto walk enabled; press K to stop
hud.mappywall.auto_elytra_active: Elytra + fireworks enabled; press K to stop
message.mappywall.stopped: MappyWall job stopped and HUD hidden.
message.mappywall.project_inactive: This job is complete and cannot be activated.
message.mappywall.complete_summary: Map-wall job complete (%s maps). Use Order in the job list to print the hanging ids.
message.mappywall.order_empty: This MappyWall job does not have any map bindings to print yet.
message.mappywall.order_not_ready: This job still has maps awaiting target-scale verification or filling, so its final hanging order is not ready.
message.mappywall.needs_empty_map: MappyWall needs an empty map for column %s, row %s.
message.mappywall.open_needs_inventory_s: The empty-map stack contains multiple maps, but there is no free inventory slot for the result. MappyWall will not risk dropping it.
message.mappywall.scale_requires_existin: Heads up: vanilla empty maps open at scale 0. Craft/zoom them afterward.
message.mappywall.scale_empty_maps_open_: Heads up: vanilla empty maps open at scale 0; MappyWall will bind this wall cell and you can craft/zoom it to the target scale afterward.
message.mappywall.open_unverified: MappyWall opened a map but could not verify that its new id belongs to the target region. It paused; resume to retry safely.
message.mappywall.open_wrong_region_retr: Map %s opened outside the current target region. It was ignored and MappyWall will retry with a new empty map.
message.mappywall.waiting_map_state: A new map id was captured; waiting for the server MapState before marking it complete.
message.mappywall.auto_walk_enabled: AUTO_WALK enabled: MappyWall will control forward movement. Press K to stop.
message.mappywall.auto_walk_aggressive_e: Aggressive auto walk enabled: you may free-look or open a screen while the server travel direction remains independent and speed-limited. Press K to stop.
message.mappywall.auto_elytra_enabled: Elytra + fireworks enabled: MappyWall will steer flight and use fireworks. Press K to stop.
message.mappywall.auto_elytra_aggressive: Aggressive Elytra + fireworks enabled: you may free-look while the server flight direction remains independent and speed-limited. Press K to stop.
message.mappywall.auto_elytra_no_elytra: Elytra + fireworks mode requires Elytra equipped in the chest slot. Paused.
message.mappywall.auto_elytra_no_firewor: Elytra + fireworks mode requires firework rockets. Paused.
message.mappywall.auto_elytra_no_launch_: This position does not have enough Elytra launch/climb space. Paused.
message.mappywall.auto_walk_stuck: AUTO_WALK detected a collision or stalled movement and paused.
message.mappywall.auto_walk_no_path: AUTO_WALK could not find a complete path and is trying local recovery.
message.mappywall.auto_walk_no_place_blo: AUTO_WALK needs to bridge, but no allowed block is available. Cobblestone and dirt are allowed by default.
message.mappywall.auto_walk_too_many_bre: AUTO_WALK has mined 9 blocks for this target and paused to avoid tunneling into terrain.
message.mappywall.fill_requires_zoomed_m: Fill-current-map needs a map zoomed to scale %s. Zoom it in a cartography table, then resume.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_open_cartogr: Aggressive auto-zoom needs an open cartography table and paper. Target scale: %s.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_no_paper: Aggressive auto-zoom needs paper, but none was found in the table or inventory.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_no_bound_map: Aggressive auto-zoom could not find the map bound to the current wall cell.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_need_space: The job map is in the offhand, but no empty inventory slot is available to move it into the cartography table.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_return_map: The map has reached its target scale. Take it back from the cartography table; MappyWall will not zoom it further.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_waiting_ack: Waiting for the server to confirm the cartography action.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_waiting_resu: Waiting for a verified cartography scaling result.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_table_busy: The cartography table contains an item or result unrelated to this job; MappyWall will not take it automatically.
message.mappywall.auto_zoom_ack_timeout: Cartography confirmation timed out. Further clicks stopped to avoid consuming another map or paper. After checking the items, pause and resume to retry explicitly.
message.mappywall.fill_map_missing: The map bound to this wall cell is not in the player inventory or offhand, so filling cannot continue safely.
message.mappywall.fill_map_not_held: Close other containers so MappyWall can safely move the current job map into the offhand.
message.mappywall.fill_offhand_required: Automatic filling leases the offhand for the job map so bridging, eating, or fireworks cannot interrupt map updates. Free the offhand first.
message.mappywall.fill_map_not_updating: The correct map did not update while waiting at the fill waypoint, so the job paused.
message.mappywall.fill_coverage_too_low: Map coverage is still only %s%% after repeated passes, so the job paused instead of marking it complete.
message.mappywall.player_state_paused: MappyWall paused safely because the player died or entered spectator mode.
message.mappywall.conflict_requires_reso: The rare map-id conflict is unresolved. Follow the red message to delete stale jobs, or supply the correct map required by this job.
message.mappywall.conflict_resolved: The map-binding conflict is resolved. The job remains paused so you can review it before resuming.
message.mappywall.cross_task_map_conflic: Map id %s is bound to different regions by these jobs: %s. Delete one or more stale jobs from the job list; retained jobs are never overwritten automatically.
message.mappywall.true_map_id_conflict_t: Map id %s has contradictory data. Jobs referencing it: %s. Review and delete stale jobs; if only one job remains and the correct map cannot be supplied, delete and recreate that job.
message.mappywall.duplicate_map_choices: Wall cell %s has equivalent maps %s; use any one of them when hanging the wall.
message.mappywall.emergency_stop: MappyWall emergency-stopped and paused the job.
